issueOrPullRequest.body:
Fix for #679 

Opening as a draft to gather some initial feedback. The main missing thing is a jitter mechanism, without it all connections that are opened simultaneously may be closed at the same time. We may want to avoid that.

This adds a `maximumConnectionLifetime` flag to the pool configuration. When the flag is set and a connection is created, a timer is scheduled. If and when the timer is triggered, the connection is closed immediately if idle, and gracefully shut down if leased (i.e the work it's doing is awaited to finish before shutting down). If, for example, the connection is closed before the timer, the timer is canceled.

This PR replaces `Max2Sequence` with `TinyFastSequence` in a bunch of places since we're now possibly carrying 3 timers instead of two, and testing showed that the synthesised Equatable conformance of `TinyFastSequence` also checked the `reservedCapacity` property, possibly yielding `false` even if the elements were equal, so this also carries a fix for that.
